howToDownload.summary: How do I download my Instagram data?
howToDownload.shortcutDescription: Go straight to the Account Center while logged in:
howToDownload.stepByStep: Or step by step from Instagram:
howToDownload.step1: Instagram → Settings → Account Center → Your information and permissions → Download your information.
howToDownload.step2: Pick only your account → under "Type of information" tick <0>Followers and following</0>.
howToDownload.step4: Request the download. It arrives by email in a few minutes.
howToDownload.step5: Download the ZIP and drag it here directly. Everything is processed locally in your browser, and only the followers/following JSONs are read from:
howToDownload.step6: You can also extract the ZIP and upload <0>following.json</0>, <1>followers_1.json</1> and <2>pending_follow_requests.json</2> separately if you prefer.

openSource.headline: 100% open source.
openSource.body: Review the code on GitHub to verify the app doesn't touch, store or send your data anywhere — it all runs in your browser.
